summary: Epsilon Energy Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register the at-the-market offering of up to $15,000,000 in common shares under an ATM agreement with Roth Capital Partners. The offering is open-ended, with no set price or number of shares; sales will be made at prevailing market prices through the agent on a commercially reasonable efforts basis. The agent receives up to 3% commission. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. No deal terms or board recommendations apply; the filing is a standard equity distribution. The ATM is typical for ongoing capital management and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
